TiaProjectSecurity.accessLevelGet.message: The CPU '(station)' has no protection levels (System:Device.S71500). On S7-1500 firmware V4.x access protection is configured with user management (UMAC) instead.
TiaProjectSecurity.accessLevelGet.hint: Use TiaUmacUser(usersList), TiaUmacUser(userAdd) and TiaUmacUser(userRoleAssign) (e.g. role PLCFAdministrator for Full access including fail-safe); see tia-mcp://docs/umac. For older firmware pass the CPU as deviceItemPath.
TiaProjectSecurity.accessLevelGet.docsHint: Guides named tia-mcp://docs/<name> can be read with resources/read or, without resource support, TiaServer(docs) with uri <name>.
